Apply only to NS-000022, organization SEA, and CASE-022. A matching title, filename, supplier, or item description is insufficient without the immutable record and released revision.

Build the supported measure from the independent observed rows and subtract only rows carrying an effective exclusion reason. Do not use archive, draft, other-case, or other-plant rows in either side of the equation.

Internal timing comes from electrical-shop base and recovery slots; external timing is conditional on seal-housing standard and expedite dates. Protected work is not displaceable. Separate approval is required for the escalation path, and a faster date does not waive the control.
